title: Mixed Event — Secret Distance — Episode1 I Want to Know More

meta.Episode: Episode1 — I Want to Know More
meta.Event Outline: In hopes of pulling Kanade out of her songwriting slump, Mizuki plans a mystery tour for a much-needed change of pace. And so begins Nightcord at 25:00's first ever day trip together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Both the song and music video needed some fine tuning, but I thought they turned out well, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! This might even be my best work yet♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, considering how much time and attention you gave it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And about our next song. You know how we talked about some rough themes last time?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I came up with a few sketches based on those. Mind taking a look?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? When did you make these? I thought you were busy editing your illustrations.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <While the video was in the final editing phase. Some ideas came into my head so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like someone's getting excited! Plus, you'll get a better picture after you hear more of the next song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sorry, about that...
I'm still working through a few ideas, so I'd like a little more time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But there's still a bunch of time until our deadline, so you don't need to rush.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And... There, I've sent you my sketches...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Wow, you made a bunch...!
Aww, the third one's so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<...
I like the very last one.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. You have a good eye. I used one of the first pieces that this artist I like made as a reference...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Y-You...! I was just trying to explain how...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wouldn't have it any other way.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mhm...!
Everything's all wrapped up, so it's time for a good night's sleep♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But when Ena ran off to SEKAI that other time, I really didn't know what would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It looks like she's having a lot more fun now, so I'm happy for her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And finding out that her dad's some famous artist was a pretty big shock...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We've all been working together for a while now, but we still don't know anything about each other.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe if we did, Ena could've talked to us about it before it sort of spun out of control...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But we really only talk while we're all working or meeting about how things are going...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What if we went on another little excursion like that time we all went to that Doll Exhibit?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu kind of had it rough that time, but we got to know a little more about her in return.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe we can learn more about each other by going somewhere we usually don't...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's spring, so everyone goes to see cherry blossoms and stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's gotta be more fun than... That's it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This class is doing a haunted house!
The decorations are really good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I bet it would give Ena the creeps. Mafuyu doesn't seem the type to get spooked by this sort of stuff though.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As for Kanade, I wonder... I kind of want to see what she's like when something startles her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What about a haunted house or something?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just found that site with a list of haunted places and sort of been wanting to check them out...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like that really creepy tunnel or that spooky shrine...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's no way they'll say yes to just going around and seeing stuff like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I need a way to goad them into going...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So many customers today...
I guess they all wanna get new clothes since it's finally starting to warm up again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now, let's get to work!
A demo for the next song should be up by now... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <I'd like to meet in SEKAI today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Pretty rare of Kanade to ask us to go to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mafuyu, Ena!
You beat me here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But where's the sender... Oh, there she is!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not like you to ask us to meet here. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's okay, Kanade.
I'm not sure what's going on, but I'm on your side, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can you tell us what happened?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I haven't been able to finish the demo version...
